relations: Gentle water ripples continuously shift the texture and brightness of the vertical reflected light column.
A thin foam line slowly advances and recedes along the shoreline, redrawing the wet sand pattern.
The sun, cliff, white building, and horizon remain stationary while the water maintains its ongoing movement.
caption: The video captures a coastal seascape at low sun beneath an overcast gray sky, where a warm halo surrounds the sun as it hangs just above the sea horizon near the center of the frame. A bright vertical column of reflected light stretches down the otherwise calm water. Its texture and brightness shift constantly as gentle ripples move across the surface. On the right, a dark headland topped by a white multi-story building rises steeply above the waterline, holding a fixed position throughout. The foreground slopes as a pebbly beach, with a small dark rock resting near the water's edge. Along this shoreline a thin foam line advances and recedes in slow, continuous motion, redrawing the wet pattern on the sand. The sun, cliff, building, and horizon remain stationary while the water keeps its quiet, ongoing movement.
